payload.reason: The evidence provides specific performance improvements of the model over state-of-the-art systems, including percentage increases in F1-scores and comparisons with baseline models.

claims.text: The model improves the macro-average F1-score by over 7% compared to previous state-of-the-art systems.
The model achieves a performance boost of 3.02 in macro F1-scores for predicting implicit discourse relations, outperforming previous models by more than 2%.
The model shows clear performance gains of around 2% to 8% on specific discourse relation classes compared to the baseline Bi-LSTM model.
